title: Selective dual-mode detection of reactive oxygen species and metal ions by chemodosimetric vs. chelation pathways: fluorescence ‘turn-on’ with OCl− and Zn2+/Mn2+, employing theoretical, practical, and bioimaging applications
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,6708-6717
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08191A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Malavika S. Kumar, Avijit Kumar Das, Yatheesharadhya Bylappa, Anish Nag
An indole-coupled diaminomaleonitrile-based fluorescent chemosensor IMA has been designed and developed for the selective detection of ROS (OCl−) and metal ions Zn2+ and Mn2+ via chemodosimetric and chelation pathways respectively.
